scope.inferenceInput: Actual saved 512-D embeddings from tests/fixtures/meaning-taxonomy/embeddings.json.gz; vectors rotate round-robin.
scope.includes: Public classifier function validation, JS preprocessing, dense head inference, and output sigmoid; measured per-call performance.now timing overhead is included.
scope.excludes: CLIP text encoding, model loading, network, Android runtime, device thermal/battery behavior.
scope.footnotes: Latency and throughput describe this desktop run only and are not phone performance claims. Float32 byte values are numeric payload estimates; actual implementation uses JavaScript Numbers and arrays, whose memory overhead is excluded.
